steps.title: Short writing
steps.prompt: Write about your childhood: where you were, what you had, what your parents were (4–5 sentences with war / hatte).
steps.promptEn: Write 4-5 German sentences about my childhood with war and hatte (where I lived, a pet or toy, my parents' jobs, how I was).
